payload.rejected_reason: high threshold can coincide with high Paris slope, so threshold alone confounds crack-initiation resistance with post-threshold growth stability

payload.interpretation: dual-phase FCC+BCC HEA records have higher median threshold than FCC records but also substantially steeper Paris slopes

science_result.gate_rule: accept two-axis damage-tolerance model if a phase group has higher median ΔKth but at least 50 percent higher median Paris slope than FCC records
science_result.new_two_axis_model: rank by both ΔKth and Paris slope m
science_result.old_scalar_model: rank FCGR resistance by ΔKth alone

payload.claim: In the open HEA FCGR dataset, threshold resistance and post-threshold crack-growth stability are decoupled: FCC+BCC records have higher median ΔKth than FCC records, but also much steeper median Paris slopes.
payload.science_value: For HEA fatigue design, screening by ΔKth alone can select alloys with poor post-threshold crack-growth stability; a two-axis threshold-slope map is the scientifically relevant descriptor.
